# 2 Baruch Chapter 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**17:1** And I answered and said: "O Lord, lo! You have announced to us the shortness of the time that has passed and the length of the time to come.

**17:2** And you have shown us that this present age is short and painful, but the future age is long and desirable.

**17:3** What have we profited by this, seeing that we came into the world in great suffering, and that we live only to be saddened all our days?

**17:4** But you have shown us that the adversary has had dominion over us. But Adam first sinned and brought death upon all those who were not of his time."

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS base throughout. "Adversary" (v.4) preferred over PNEUMA's "enemy" — "adversary" is the established rendering of the satan figure in Syriac apocalyptic. "Desirable" (v.2) preferred over PNEUMA's "something to look forward to" — the participial adjective is more precisely eschatological.*
